records.name: Rally
records.text: Once per session, describe how you rally the party and give yourself and each of your allies a Rally Die. At level 1, your Rally Die is a **d6**. A PC can spend their Rally Die to roll it, adding the result to their action roll, reaction roll, damage roll, or to clear a number of Stress equal to the result. At the end of each session, clear all unspent Rally Dice. At level 5, your Rally Die increases to a **d8**.

records.name: Make a Scene
records.text: **Spend 3 Hope** to temporarily *Distract* a target within Close range, giving them a -2 penalty to their Difficulty.

records.name: Gifted Performer
records.text:
You can play three different types of songs, once each per long rest; describe how you perform for others to gain the listed benefit:

- ***Relaxing Song:*** You and all allies within Close range clear a Hit Point.
- ***Epic Song:*** Make a target within Close range temporarily *Vulnerable*.
- ***Heartbreaking Song:*** You and all allies within Close range gain a Hope.

records.name: Maestro
records.text: Your rallying songs steel the courage of those who listen. When you give a Rally Die to an ally, they can gain a Hope or clear a Stress.

records.name: Virtuoso
records.text: You are among the greatest of your craft and your skill is boundless. You can perform each of your "Gifted Performer" feature's songs twice per long rest.

records.name: Rousing Speech
records.text: Once per long rest, you can give a heartfelt, inspiring speech. All allies within Far range clear 2 Stress.

records.name: Heart of a Poet
records.text: After you make an action roll to impress, persuade, or offend someone, you can **spend a Hope** to add a **d4** to the roll.

records.name: Eloquent
records.text:
Your moving words boost morale. Once per session, when you encourage an ally, you can do one of the following:

- Allow them to find a mundane object or tool they need.
- Help an Ally without spending Hope.
- Give them an additional downtime move during their next rest.

records.name: Epic Poetry
records.text: Your Rally Die increases to a **d10**. Additionally, when you Help an Ally, you can narrate the moment as if you were writing the tale of their heroism in a memoir. When you do, roll a **d10** as your advantage die.

records.name: Beastform
records.text: **Mark a Stress** to magically transform into a creature of your tier or lower from the Beastform list. You can drop out of this form at any time. While transformed, you can't use weapons or cast spells from domain cards, but you can still use other features or abilities you have access to. Spells you cast before you transform stay active and last for their normal duration, and you can talk and communicate as normal. Additionally, you gain the Beastform's features, add their Evasion bonus to your Evasion, and use the trait specified in their statistics for your attack. While you're in a Beastform, your armor becomes part of your body and you mark Armor Slots as usual; when you drop out of a Beastform, those marked Armor Slots remain marked. If you mark your last Hit Point, you automatically drop out of this form.

records.name: Wildtouch
records.text: You can perform harmless, subtle effects that involve nature—such as causing a flower to rapidly grow, summoning a slight gust of wind, or starting a campfire—at will.

records.name: Evolution
records.text: **Spend 3 Hope** to transform into a ***Beastform*** without marking a Stress. When you do, choose one trait to raise by +1 until you drop out of that Beastform.

records.name: Elemental Incarnation
records.text:
**Mark a Stress** to *Channel* one of the following elements until you take Severe damage or until your next rest:

- ***Fire:*** When an adversary within Melee range deals damage to you, they take **1d10** magic damage.
- ***Earth:*** Gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your Proficiency.
- ***Water:*** When you deal damage to an adversary within Melee range, all other adversaries within Very Close range must mark a Stress.
- ***Air:*** You can hover, gaining advantage on Agility Rolls.

mechanics.note: Channeled element is chosen when the feature is used; Earth's threshold bonus applies only while channeling.

records.name: Elemental Aura
records.text:
Once per rest while *Channeling*, you can assume an aura matching your element. The aura affects targets within Close range until your *Channeling* ends.

- ***Fire:*** When an adversary marks 1 or more Hit Points, they must also mark a Stress.
- ***Earth:*** Your allies gain a +1 bonus to Strength.
- ***Water:*** When an adversary deals damage to you, you can **mark a Stress** to move them anywhere within Very Close range of where they are.
- ***Air:*** When you or an ally takes damage from an attack beyond Melee range, reduce the damage by **1d8**.

records.name: Elemental Dominion
records.text:
You further embody your element. While *Channeling*, you gain the following benefit:

- ***Fire:*** You gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for attacks and spells that deal damage.
- ***Earth:*** When you would mark Hit Points, roll a **d6** per Hit Point marked. For each result of 6, reduce the number of Hit Points you mark by 1.
- ***Water:*** When an attack against you succeeds, you can **mark a Stress** to make the attacker temporarily *Vulnerable*.
- ***Air:*** You gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion and can fly.

records.name: Clarity of Nature
records.text: Once per long rest, you can create a space of natural serenity within Close range. When you spend a few minutes resting within the space, clear Stress equal to your Instinct, distributed as you choose between you and your allies.

records.name: Regeneration
records.text: Touch a creature and **spend 3 Hope**. That creature clears **1d4** Hit Points.

records.name: Regenerative Reach
records.text: You can target creatures within Very Close range with your "Regeneration" feature.

records.name: Warden's Protection
records.text: Once per long rest, **spend 2 Hope** to clear 2 Hit Points on **1d4** allies within Close range.

records.name: Defender
records.text: Your animal transformation embodies a healing guardian spirit. When you're in Beastform and an ally within Close range marks 2 or more Hit Points, you can **mark a Stress** to reduce the number of Hit Points they mark by 1.

records.name: Unstoppable
records.text:
Once per long rest, you can become *Unstoppable*. You gain an Unstoppable Die. At level 1, your Unstoppable Die is a **d4**. Place it on your character sheet in the space provided, starting with the 1 value facing up. After you make a damage roll that deals 1 or more Hit Points to a target, increase the Unstoppable Die value by one. When the die's value would exceed its maximum value or when the scene ends, remove the die and drop out of *Unstoppable*. At level 5, your Unstoppable Die increases to a **d6**.

While *Unstoppable*, you gain the following benefits:

- You reduce the severity of physical damage by one threshold (Severe to Major, Major to Minor, Minor to None).
- You add the current value of the Unstoppable Die to your damage roll.
- You can't be *Restrained* or *Vulnerable*.

records.name: Frontline Tank
records.text: **Spend 3 Hope** to clear 2 Armor Slots.

records.name: Unwavering
records.text: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your damage thresholds.

records.name: Iron Will
records.text: When you take physical damage, you can **mark an additional Armor Slot** to reduce the severity.

records.name: Unrelenting
records.text: Gain a permanent +2 bonus to your damage thresholds.

records.name: Partners-in-Arms
records.text: When an ally within Very Close range takes damage, you can **mark an Armor Slot** to reduce the severity by one threshold.

records.name: Undaunted
records.text: Gain a permanent +3 bonus to your damage thresholds.

records.name: Loyal Protector
records.text: When an ally within Close range has 2 or fewer Hit Points and would take damage, you can **mark a Stress** to sprint to their side and take the damage instead.

records.name: At Ease
records.text: Gain an additional Stress slot.

records.name: Revenge
records.text: When an adversary within Melee range succeeds on an attack against you, you can **mark 2 Stress** to force the attacker to mark a Hit Point.

records.name: Act of Reprisal
records.text: When an adversary damages an ally within Melee range, you gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for the next successful attack you make against that adversary.

records.name: Nemesis
records.text: **Spend 2 Hope** to *Prioritize* an adversary until your next rest. When you make an attack against your *Prioritized* adversary, you can swap the results of your Hope and Fear Dice. You can only Prioritize one adversary at a time.

records.name: Ranger's Focus
records.text:
**Spend a Hope** and make an attack against a target. On a success, deal your attack's normal damage and temporarily make the attack's target your *Focus*. Until this feature ends or you make a different creature your *Focus*, you gain the following benefits against your *Focus*:

- You know precisely what direction they are in.
- When you deal damage to them, they must mark a Stress.
- When you fail an attack against them, you can end your "Ranger's Focus" feature to reroll your Duality Dice.

records.name: Hold Them Off
records.text: **Spend 3 Hope** when you succeed on an attack with a weapon to use that same roll against two additional adversaries within range of the attack.

records.name: Companion
records.text:
You have an animal companion of your choice (at the GM's discretion). They stay by your side unless you tell them otherwise.

Take the Ranger Companion sheet. When you level up your character, choose a level-up option for your companion from this sheet as well.

companion.source: Evasion 10, Melee d6 attack, physical-or-magic choice and two +2 Experiences (with the example list): SRD 2.0 'Ranger Companion' section. Starting Stress slots (3): the official Ranger Companion character sheet as transcribed by Old Gus; not stated in the SRD 2.0 text (RD-029).
exampleExperiences: You Can't Hit What You Can't Find

advancements.label: Intelligent
advancements.text: Your companion gains a permanent +1 bonus to a Companion Experience of your choice.

advancements.label: Light in the Dark
advancements.text: Use this as an additional Hope slot your character can mark.

advancements.label: Creature Comfort
advancements.text: Once per rest, when you take time during a quiet moment to give your companion love and attention, you can gain a Hope or you can both clear a Stress.

advancements.label: Armored
advancements.text: When your companion takes damage, you can mark one of your Armor Slots instead of marking one of their Stress.

advancements.label: Vicious
advancements.text: Increase your companion's damage dice or range by one step (d6 to d8, Close to Far, etc.).

advancements.label: Resilient
advancements.text: Your companion gains an additional Stress slot.

advancements.label: Bonded
advancements.text: When you mark your last Hit Point, your companion rushes to your side to comfort you. Roll a number of d6s equal to the unmarked Stress slots they have and mark them. If any roll a 6, your companion helps you up. Clear your last Hit Point and return to the scene.

advancements.label: Aware
advancements.text: Your companion gains a permanent +2 bonus to their Evasion.

companion.advancementSource: Option text: SRD 2.0 'Leveling Up Your Companion'. Slot counts: official Ranger Companion sheet as transcribed by Old Gus (not stated in the SRD text). Old Gus gives Aware as +1 Evasion; the official SRD says +2, which is used.

records.name: Expert Training
records.text: Choose an additional level-up option for your companion.

records.name: Advanced Training
records.text: Choose two additional level-up options for your companion.

records.name: Loyal Friend
records.text: Once per long rest, when the damage from an attack would mark your companion's last Stress or your last Hit Point and you're within Close range of each other, you or your companion can rush to the other's side and take that damage instead.

records.name: Ruthless Predator
records.text: When you make a damage roll, you can **mark a Stress** to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency. Additionally, when you deal Severe damage to an adversary, they must mark a Stress.

records.name: Path Forward
records.text: When you're traveling to a place you've previously visited or you carry an object that has been at the location before, you can identify the shortest, most direct path to your destination.

records.name: Elusive Predator
records.text: When your *Focus* makes an attack against you, you gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against the attack.

records.name: Apex Predator
records.text: Before you make an attack roll against your *Focus*, you can **spend a Hope**. On a successful attack, you remove a Fear from the GM's Fear pool.

records.name: Cloaked
records.text: Any time you would be *Hidden*, you are instead *Cloaked*. In addition to the benefits of the *Hidden* condition, while *Cloaked* you remain unseen if you are stationary when an adversary moves to where they would normally see you. After you make an attack or end a move within line of sight of an adversary, you are no longer *Cloaked*.

records.name: Sneak Attack
records.text: When you succeed on an attack while *Cloaked* or while an ally is within Melee range of your target, add a number of **d6s** equal to your tier to your damage roll.

records.name: Rogue's Dodge
records.text: **Spend 3 Hope** to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion until the next time an attack succeeds against you. Otherwise, this bonus lasts until your next rest.

records.name: Shadow Stepper
records.text: You can move from shadow to shadow. When you move into an area of darkness or a shadow cast by another creature or object, you can **mark a Stress** to disappear from where you are and reappear inside another shadow within Far range. When you reappear, you are *Cloaked*.

records.name: Dark Cloud
records.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (15)**. On a success, create a temporary dark cloud that covers any area within Close range. Anyone in this cloud can't see outside of it, and anyone outside of it can't see in. You're considered *Cloaked* from any adversary for whom the cloud blocks line of sight.

records.name: Adrenaline
records.text: While you're Vulnerable, add your level to your damage rolls.

records.name: Fleeting Shadow
records.text: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion. You can use your "Shadow Stepper" feature to move within Very Far range.

records.name: Vanishing Act
records.text: **Mark a Stress** to become *Cloaked* at any time. When *Cloaked* from this feature, you automatically clear the *Restrained* condition if you have it. You remain *Cloaked* in this way until you roll with Fear or until your next rest.

records.name: Well-Connected
records.text:
When you arrive in a prominent town or environment, you know somebody who calls this place home. Give them a name, note how you think they could be useful, and choose one fact from the following list:

- They owe me a favor, but they'll be hard to find.
- They're going to ask for something in exchange.
- They're always in a great deal of trouble.
- We used to be together. It's a long story.
- We didn't part on great terms.

mechanics.note: Contacts are created when arriving somewhere, not at character creation.

records.name: Contacts Everywhere
records.text:
Once per session, you can briefly call on a shady contact. Choose one of the following benefits and describe what brought them here to help you in this moment:

- They provide 1 handful of gold, a unique tool, or a mundane object that the situation requires.
- On your next action roll, their help provides a +3 bonus to the result of your Hope or Fear Die.
- The next time you deal damage, they snipe from the shadows, adding **2d8** to your damage roll.

records.name: Reliable Backup
records.text:
You can use your "Contacts Everywhere" feature three times per session. The following options are added to the list of benefits you can choose from when you use that feature:

- When you mark 1 or more Hit Points, they can rush out to shield you, reducing the Hit Points marked by 1.
- When you make a Presence Roll in conversation, they back you up. You can roll a **d20** as your Hope Die.

records.name: Prayer Dice
records.text: At the beginning of each session, roll a number of **d4s** equal to your subclass's Spellcast trait and place them on your character sheet in the space provided. These are your Prayer Dice. You can spend any number of Prayer Dice to aid yourself or an ally within Far range. You can use a spent die's value to reduce incoming damage, add to a roll's result after the roll is made, or gain Hope equal to the result. At the end of each session, clear all unspent Prayer Dice.

records.name: Life Support
records.text: **Spend 3 Hope** to clear a Hit Point on an ally within Close range.

records.name: Spirit Weapon
records.text: When you have an equipped weapon with a range of Melee or Very Close, it can fly from your hand to attack an adversary within Close range and then return to you. You can **mark a Stress** to target an additional adversary within range with the same attack roll.

records.name: Sparing Touch
records.text: Once per long rest, touch a creature and clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress from them.

records.name: Devout
records.text: When you roll your Prayer Dice, you can roll an additional die and discard the lowest result. Additionally, you can use your "Sparing Touch" feature twice instead of once per long rest.

records.name: Sacred Resonance
records.text: When you roll damage for your "Spirit Weapon" feature, if any of the die results match, double the value of each matching die. For example, if you roll two 5s, they count as two 10s.

records.name: Wings of Light
records.text:
You can fly. While flying, you can do the following:

- **Mark a Stress** to pick up and carry another willing creature approximately your size or smaller.
- **Spend a Hope** to deal an extra **1d8** damage on a successful attack.

records.name: Ethereal Visage
records.text: Your supernatural visage strikes awe and fear. While flying, you have advantage on Presence Rolls. When you succeed with Hope on a Presence Roll, you can remove a Fear from the GM's Fear pool instead of gaining Hope.

records.name: Ascendant
records.text: Gain a permanent +4 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.

records.name: Power of the Gods
records.text: While flying, you deal an extra **1d12** damage instead of 1d8 from your "Wings of Light" feature.

records.name: Arcane Sense
records.text: You can sense the presence of magical people and objects within Close range.

records.name: Minor Illusion
records.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (10)**. On a success, you create a minor visual illusion no larger than yourself within Close range. This illusion is convincing to anyone at Close range or farther.

records.name: Channel Raw Power
records.text:
Once per long rest, you can place a domain card from your loadout into your vault and choose to either:

- Gain Hope equal to the level of the card.
- Enhance a spell that deals damage, gaining a bonus to your damage roll equal to twice the level of the card.

records.name: Volatile Magic
records.text: **Spend 3 Hope** to reroll any number of your damage dice on an attack that deals magic damage.

records.name: Elementalist
records.text:
Choose one of the following elements at character creation: air, earth, fire, lightning, water. You can shape this element into harmless effects.

Additionally, **spend a Hope** and describe how your control over this element helps an action roll you're about to make, then either gain a +2 bonus to the roll or a +3 bonus to the roll's damage.

records.name: Natural Evasion
records.text: You can call forth your element to protect you from harm. When an attack roll against you succeeds, you can **mark a Stress** and describe how you use your element to defend you. When you do, roll a **d6** and add its result to your Evasion against the attack.

records.name: Transcendence
records.text:
Once per long rest, you can transform into a physical manifestation of your element. When you do, describe your transformation and choose two of the following benefits to gain until your next rest:

- +4 bonus to your Severe threshold
- +1 bonus to a character trait of your choice
- +1 bonus to your Proficiency
- +2 bonus to your Evasion

mechanics.note: Benefits are chosen each time you transform and last until your next rest.

records.name: Manipulate Magic
records.text:
Your primal origin allows you to modify the essence of magic itself. After you cast a spell or make an attack using a weapon that deals magic damage, you can **mark a Stress** to do one of the following:

- Extend the spell or attack's reach by one range
- Gain a +2 bonus to the action roll's result
- Double a damage die of your choice
- Hit an additional target within range

records.name: Enchanted Aid
records.text: You can enhance the magic of others with your essence. When you Help an Ally with a Spellcast Roll, you can roll a **d8** as your advantage die. Once per long rest, after an ally has made a Spellcast Roll with your help, you can swap the results of their Duality Dice.

records.name: Arcane Charge
records.text: You can gather magical energy to enhance your capabilities. When you take magic damage, you become *Charged*. Alternatively, you can **spend 2 Hope** to become *Charged*. When you successfully make an attack that deals magic damage while *Charged*, you can clear your Charge to either gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll or gain a +3 bonus to the Difficulty of a reaction roll the spell causes the target to make. You stop being *Charged* at your next long rest.

records.name: Attack of Opportunity
records.text:
If an adversary within Melee range attempts to leave that range, make a reaction roll using a trait of your choice against their Difficulty. Choose one effect on a success, or two if you critically succeed:

- They can't move from where they are.
- You deal damage to them equal to your primary weapon's damage.
- You move with them.

records.name: Combat Training
records.text: You ignore burden when equipping weapons. When you deal physical damage, you gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to your level.

records.name: No Mercy
records.text: **Spend 3 Hope** to gain a +1 bonus to your attack rolls until your next rest.

records.name: Courage
records.text: When you fail a roll with Fear, you gain a Hope.

records.name: Battle Ritual
records.text: Once per long rest, before you attempt something incredibly dangerous or face off against a foe who clearly outmatches you, describe what ritual you perform or preparations you make. When you do, clear 2 Stress and gain 2 Hope.

records.name: Rise to the Challenge
records.text: You are vigilant in the face of mounting danger. While you have 2 or fewer Hit Points unmarked, you can roll a **d20** as your Hope Die.

records.name: Camaraderie
records.text: Your unwavering bravery is a rallying point for your allies. You can initiate a Tag Team Roll one additional time per session. Additionally, when an ally initiates a Tag Team Roll with you, they only need to spend 2 Hope to do so.

records.name: Slayer
records.text: You gain a pool of dice called Slayer Dice. On a roll with Hope, you can place a **d6** on this card instead of gaining a Hope, adding the die to the pool. You can store a number of Slayer Dice equal to your Proficiency. When you make an attack roll or damage roll, you can spend any number of these Slayer Dice, rolling them and adding their result to the roll. At the end of each session, clear any unspent Slayer Dice on this card and gain a Hope per die cleared.

records.name: Weapon Specialist
records.text: You can wield multiple weapons with dangerous ease. When you succeed on an attack, you can **spend a Hope** to add one of the damage dice from your secondary weapon to the damage roll. Additionally, once per long rest when you roll your Slayer Dice, reroll any 1s.

records.name: Martial Preparation
records.text: You're an inspirational warrior to all who travel with you. Your party gains access to the Martial Preparation downtime move. To use this move during a rest, describe how you instruct and train with your party. You and each ally who chooses this downtime move gain a **d6** Slayer Die. A PC with a Slayer Die can spend it to roll the die and add the result to an attack or damage roll of their choice.

records.name: Prestidigitation
records.text: You can perform harmless, subtle magical effects at will. For example, you can change an object's color, create a smell, light a candle, cause a tiny object to float, illuminate a room, or repair a small object.

records.name: Strange Patterns
records.text:
Choose a number between 1 and 12. When you roll that number on a Duality Die, gain a Hope or clear a Stress.

You can change this number when you take a long rest.

choice.label: Chosen number
choice.note: Can be changed on a long rest.

records.name: Not This Time
records.text: **Spend 3 Hope** to force an adversary within Far range to reroll an attack or damage roll.

records.name: Prepared
records.text: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

records.name: Adept
records.text: When you Utilize an Experience, you can **mark a Stress** instead of spending a Hope. If you do, double your Experience modifier for that roll.

records.name: Accomplished
records.text: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

records.name: Perfect Recall
records.text: Once per rest, when you recall a domain card in your vault, you can reduce its Recall Cost by 1.

records.name: Brilliant
records.text: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

records.name: Honed Expertise
records.text: When you use an Experience, roll a **d6**. On a result of 5 or higher, you can use it without spending Hope.

records.name: Battlemage
records.text: You've focused your studies on becoming an unconquerable force on the battlefield. Gain an additional Hit Point slot.

records.name: Face Your Fear
records.text: When you succeed with Fear on an attack roll, you deal an extra **1d10** magic damage.

records.name: Conjure Shield
records.text: You can maintain a protective barrier of magic. While you have at least 2 Hope, you add your Proficiency to your Evasion.

mechanics.note: Adds Proficiency to Evasion only while you have at least 2 Hope.

records.name: Fueled by Fear
records.text: The extra magic damage from your "Face Your Fear" feature increases to **2d10**.

records.name: Thrive in Chaos
records.text: When you succeed on an attack, you can **mark a Stress** after rolling damage to force the target to mark an additional Hit Point.

records.name: Have No Fear
records.text: The extra magic damage from your "Face Your Fear" feature increases to **3d10**.

records.name: Purposeful Design
records.text: Decide who made you and for what purpose. At character creation, choose one of your Experiences that best aligns with this purpose and gain a permanent +1 bonus to it.

records.name: Efficient
records.text: When you take a short rest, you can choose a long rest move instead of a short rest move.

records.name: Scales
records.text: Your scales act as natural protection. When you would take Severe damage, you can **mark a Stress** to mark 1 fewer Hit Points.

records.name: Elemental Breath
records.text: Choose an element for your breath (such as electricity, fire, or ice). You can use this breath against a target or group of targets within Very Close range, treating it as an Instinct weapon that deals **d8** magic damage using your Proficiency.

choice.label: Breath element
choice.note: Options limited to the SRD's examples.

records.name: Thick Skin
records.text: When you take Minor damage, you can **mark 2 Stress** instead of marking a Hit Point.

records.name: Increased Fortitude
records.text: **Spend 3 Hope** to halve incoming physical damage.

records.name: Quick Reactions
records.text: **Mark a Stress** to gain advantage on a reaction roll.

records.name: Celestial Trance
records.text: During a rest, you can drop into a trance to choose an additional downtime move.

records.name: Luckbender
records.text: Once per session, after you or a willing ally within Close range makes an action roll, you can spend 3 Hope to reroll the Duality Dice.

records.name: Wings
records.text: You can fly. While flying, you can **mark a Stress** after an adversary makes an attack against you to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against that attack.

records.name: Caprine Leap
records.text: You can leap anywhere within Close range as though you were using normal movement, allowing you to vault obstacles, jump across gaps, or scale barriers with ease.

records.name: Kick
records.text: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to kick yourself off them, dealing an extra **2d6** damage and knocking back either yourself or the target to Very Close range.

records.name: Charge
records.text: When you succeed on an Agility Roll to move from Far or Very Far range into Melee range with one or more targets, you can **mark a Stress** to deal **1d12** physical damage to all targets within Melee range.

records.name: Unshakable
records.text: When you would mark a Stress, roll a **d6**. On a result of 6, don't mark it.

records.name: Fungril Network
records.text: Make an **Instinct Roll (12)** to use your mycelial array to speak with others of your ancestry. On a success, you can communicate across any distance.

records.name: Death Connection
records.text: While touching a corpse that died recently, you can **mark a Stress** to extract one memory from the corpse related to a specific emotion or sensation of your choice.

records.name: Shell
records.text: Gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your Proficiency.

records.name: Retract
records.text: **Mark a Stress** to retract into your shell. While in your shell, you have resistance to physical damage, you have disadvantage on action rolls, and you can't move.

records.name: Endurance
records.text: Gain an additional Hit Point slot at character creation.

records.name: Reach
records.text: Treat any weapon, ability, spell, or other feature that has a Melee range as though it has a Very Close range instead.

records.name: Surefooted
records.text: You ignore disadvantage on Agility Rolls.

records.name: Danger Sense
records.text: Once per rest, mark a Stress to force an adversary to reroll an attack against you or an ally within Very Close range.

records.name: Luckbringer
records.text: At the start of each session, everyone in your party gains a Hope.

records.name: Internal Compass
records.text: When you roll a 1 on your Hope Die, you can reroll it.

records.name: High Stamina
records.text: Gain an additional Stress slot at character creation.

records.name: Adaptability
records.text: When you fail a roll that utilized one of your Experiences, you can **mark a Stress** to reroll.

records.name: Fearless
records.text: When you roll with Fear, you can **mark 2 Stress** to change it into a roll with Hope instead.

records.name: Dread Visage
records.text: You have advantage on rolls to intimidate hostile creatures.

records.name: Feline Instincts
records.text: When you make an Agility Roll, you can **spend 2 Hope** to reroll your Hope Die.

records.name: Retracting Claws
records.text: Make an **Agility Roll** to scratch a target within Melee range. On a success, they become temporarily *Vulnerable*.

records.name: Sturdy
records.text: When you have 1 Hit Point remaining, attacks against you have disadvantage.

records.name: Tusks
records.text: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Melee range, you can **spend a Hope** to gore the target with your tusks, dealing an extra **1d6** damage.

records.name: Amphibious
records.text: You can breathe and move naturally underwater.

records.name: Long Tongue
records.text: You can use your long tongue to grab onto things within Close range. **Mark a Stress** to use your tongue as a Finesse Close weapon that deals **d12** physical damage using your Proficiency.

records.name: Natural Climber
records.text: You have advantage on Agility Rolls that involve balancing and climbing.

records.name: Nimble
records.text: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion at character creation.

records.name: Privilege
records.text: You have advantage on rolls to consort with nobles, negotiate prices, or leverage your reputation to get what you want.

records.name: Well-Read
records.text: You have advantage on rolls that involve the history, culture, or politics of a prominent person or place.

records.name: Dedicated
records.text: Record three sayings or values your upbringing instilled in you. Once per rest, when you describe how you're embodying one of these principles through your current action, you can roll a **d20** as your Hope Die.

records.name: Steady
records.text: You have advantage on rolls to traverse dangerous cliffs and ledges, navigate harsh environments, and use your survival knowledge.

records.name: Know the Tide
records.text: You can sense the ebb and flow of life. When you roll with Fear, place a token on your community card. You can hold a number of tokens equal to your level. Before you make an action roll, you can spend any number of these tokens to gain a +1 bonus to the roll for each token spent. At the end of each session, clear all unspent tokens.

records.name: Scoundrel
records.text: You have advantage on rolls to negotiate with criminals, detect lies, or find a safe place to hide.

records.name: Low-Light Living
records.text: When you're in an area with low light or heavy shadow, you have advantage on rolls to hide, investigate, or perceive details within that area.

records.name: Nomadic Pack
records.text: Add a ***Nomadic Pack*** to your inventory. Once per session, you can **spend a Hope** to reach into this pack and pull out a mundane item that's useful to your situation. Work with the GM to figure out what item you take out.

records.name: Lightfoot
records.text: Your movement is naturally silent. You have advantage on rolls to move without being heard.
